title: Android Developer Validation Entrypoint
problem: Android has reliable unit/build and smoke regression pieces, but no single developer-facing local validation command that composes them and writes one report.
summary: Closed lane for a local Android validation entrypoint that wraps Gradle gates and smoke regression without duplicating ADB or UI navigation.
